agents.name: Opportunity Scout
agents.mission: Continuously discover relevant public-sector opportunities from approved procurement sources.

agents.name: Source Monitor
agents.mission: Monitor approved sources for new, amended, cancelled, or awarded solicitations.

agents.name: Opportunity Deduplication Agent
agents.mission: Detect duplicate listings and merge records without losing provenance.

agents.name: Opportunity Analyst
agents.mission: Extract scope, agency, value, vehicle, dates, NAICS, set-aside and submission requirements.

agents.name: Bid Fit Scorer
agents.mission: Score strategic and technical fit against ProcessPilot capabilities and priorities.

agents.name: Bid / No-Bid Advisor
agents.mission: Recommend pursue, watch, partner, or decline based on fit, risk, timing and economics.

agents.name: Capture Analyst
agents.mission: Develop capture strategy for priority pursuits.

agents.name: Deadline Monitor
agents.mission: Track Q&A, amendment, registration, proposal and award dates.

agents.name: Agency Researcher
agents.mission: Research buyer mission, programs, budgets, leadership and procurement history.

agents.name: Incumbent Researcher
agents.mission: Identify incumbents, prior awards and likely competitors.

agents.name: Partner & Teaming Researcher
agents.mission: Identify potential subcontractors, primes and capability partners.

agents.name: Requirements Analyst
agents.mission: Translate solicitation requirements into a response-ready work breakdown.

agents.name: Compliance Matrix Builder
agents.mission: Build and maintain the authoritative solicitation compliance matrix.

agents.name: Clause & Terms Analyst
agents.mission: Identify contractual clauses, certifications, representations and material risk terms.

agents.name: Registration & Eligibility Analyst
agents.mission: Verify registrations, licenses, certifications and eligibility prerequisites.
agents.approval: Opara for new registrations or attestations

agents.name: Proposal Manager
agents.mission: Orchestrate proposal development, owners, sections, reviews and final package readiness.

agents.name: Proposal Writer
agents.mission: Draft compliant, tailored proposal narratives using approved company facts.

agents.name: Technical Solution Writer
agents.mission: Draft technical approach, architecture, implementation and security content.

agents.name: Executive Summary Writer
agents.mission: Create concise executive narratives aligned to buyer outcomes and win themes.

agents.name: Proposal Quality Reviewer
agents.mission: Review proposals for compliance, clarity, evidence, consistency and evaluator usability.

agents.name: Past Performance Curator
agents.mission: Select and tailor relevant past performance and capability evidence.

agents.name: Pricing Analyst
agents.mission: Develop price structures and scenario models consistent with solicitation instructions.

agents.name: Margin & Risk Reviewer
agents.mission: Review price-to-win, margin, cash-flow and financial risk.

agents.name: Procurement Outreach Drafter
agents.mission: Draft professional agency, partner and vendor communications.
agents.approval: Opara before external send unless pre-approved template

agents.name: Outreach Coordinator
agents.mission: Track approved external communications and responses.

agents.name: Contracts Reviewer
agents.mission: Review award and contract documents for obligations, exceptions and execution risks.

agents.name: Award Monitor
agents.mission: Track notices, award decisions, debriefings and post-submission changes.

agents.name: Engagement Manager
agents.mission: Convert awards into kickoff plans, milestones, owners and delivery governance.
agents.approval: Opara for material scope or commercial changes

agents.name: Performance Analyst
agents.mission: Track delivery outcomes, lessons learned, references and reusable evidence.

agents.name: Executive Briefing Agent
agents.mission: Aggregate decision-ready information for Opara and record the resulting decision.
